description: Source code for managing device metadata, including creation, cloning, serialization to JSON, and deserialization from JSON.

methods.name: metadataDestroy
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for an icDeviceMetadata object and its fields.

methods.name: metadataDestroy__auto
methods.description: Inline function to automatically destroy icDeviceMetadata pointer.

methods.name: metadataPrint
methods.description: Logs the details of an icDeviceMetadata object with a given prefix.

methods.name: metadataClone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an icDeviceMetadata object.

methods.name: metadataToJSON
methods.description: Converts an icDeviceMetadata object to a cJSON JSON representation.

methods.name: metadatasToJSON
methods.description: Converts a list of icDeviceMetadata objects to a JSON object keyed by metadata id.

methods.name: metadataFromJSON
methods.description: Creates an icDeviceMetadata object from JSON data, associating it with device and endpoint IDs.

methods.name: metadatasFromJSON
methods.description: Creates a list of icDeviceMetadata objects from JSON array, for a specific device and endpoint.
